Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap for your execs and to make sure we're aligned on next steps.

- Lack of clear SLAs from current provider; impact to revenue-critical reports

   - Success metrics: avg cost/token, p95 latency, error rate <= 0.5%
2) Procurement: connect to procurement/legal (you mentioned procurement@vertexsystems.com) — they need SOW + SOC2 + DPA summary

Marissa / Jonas — high-level executive recap and recommended approach for Vertex (send this back to Daniel & Lisa as the exec note).

Executive summary (one-paragraph):
Redwood recommends a time-boxed 6-week pilot on Dedicated (us-east-1) focused on search + one chat flow to validate cost-per-inference and latency under production-like load. If pilot meets pre-agreed KPIs (p95 latency < 300ms; cost/token improvement >= 30%; error rate < 0.5%), we propose converting to a 6-month committed plan with volume discounts and SLA credits.

Business outcomes:
- Predictable unit economics (target: 30–40% cost reduction)
- Lower tail latency and improved reliability during peak windows
- Faster incident-forensics with audit logs for finance/regulatory needs

Top risks and mitigations:
- Data residency: Vertex requires US-only residency — we will provision Dedicated capacity in us-east-1 and confirm network controls. (Mitigation: private VPC peering + KMS integration)
- Legal/DPA: Vertex legal may request DPA edits. Provide Redwood standard DPA and SOC2 Type II report — expect 3–5 business days for legal review initially.
- Procurement timeline: Procurement approval could slip; propose an exec-level alignment call with procurement + legal next week to unblock (Marissa to coordinate).

Procurement path & ask:
1) Send SOW + SOC2 summary + DPA template to procurement@vertexsystems.com (Marissa to send).
2) Request procurement/legal confirm required edits and indicate approval timeline.
3) If legal requests custom DPA language, we will route to our legal team and aim for a redline turnaround within 3–5 business days.

Commercial recommendation:
- Pilot: 6 weeks on Dedicated (scoped routes) — fixed pilot fee $X (Jonas: please insert pilot fee ranges).
- Post-pilot: 6-month committed capacity with 15%–25% volume discount depending on commit level. Include SLA with credits tied to availability/latency targets.
